name: At what point in a bathroom remodel should the new flooring be installed?

mainEntity.name: At what point in a bathroom remodel should the new flooring be installed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bathroom flooring is normally installed after drywall finishing, painting, and primary plumbing rough-ins, but before the vanity, base trim, and toilet are set. Placing tile underneath freestanding vanities and toilets ensures a seamless, watertight barrier across the entire floor plan. This sequence also allows future fixture updates without leaving exposed subfloor gaps. If a heavy custom vanity is planned, craftsmen coordinate height and plumbing alignment carefully so the flooring underlayment integrates cleanly with adjacent room transitions.
acceptedAnswer.description: Flooring is installed after plumbing rough-ins and wall painting, but before installing the vanity, toilet, and baseboards to ensure complete, watertight coverage.
